task: read-only bounded discovery: selection cost in outer_learning_runtime/load_shadow
method: source reading + filesystem stat only; no reruns, no loads, no writes to production data

files_read_per_load_shadow_call.path: each of the 97 manifest-pinned run records (77 present, 20 /tmp scan fixtures MISSING)
files_read_per_load_shadow_call.ref: meta_outcome_dataset.clj:262 read-bytes default Files/readAllBytes; sha256 per record :269; edn/read-string per record ~:285

findings.full_history_reprocessed_every_selection: Yes. load_shadow is invoked on every outer selection (select_live -> production_provider -> load_shadow) and re-reads + re-sha256s + re-EDN-parses every manifest-pinned run record each time: ~560 MB of EDN parsed per selection, growing each day. 20 of 97 manifest entries point at vanished /tmp/click-scan-* fixtures and cost a failing open each run (meta_outcome_dataset.clj:58-66).
findings.canonicalization: canonical/digest do NOT run over full run records in produce: records are byte-sha256'd (:269) and field-extracted (selected-target, terminal-cause, timings). canonical+digest run over (a) the merged manifest body in manifest-check (meta_outcome_dataset.clj:29, manifest-from outer_learning_runtime.clj:17-18), (b) interoceptive-evidence bodies (:143), (c) the final dataset body source-pin (:405). These bodies are summaries (rows/exclusions/counts), so the sampled canonical frames are the tail of per-selection digest work, not the bulk. The bulk cost is 560 MB of Files/readAllBytes + edn/read-string + per-record sha256, repeated every click.
findings.canonical_key_compare_cost: meta_field_observation.clj:30 compares keys by (compare (pr-str left) (pr-str right)) - re-prints keys at every comparison (O(n log n) pr-str per map). Worth fixing only if digests ever cover big maps; today they don't.

smallest_semantics_preserving_speedup.primary_corrected: A manifest-keyed cache of produce/output is NOT semantics-preserving: produce re-verifies each record's bytes against its pin at read time (meta_outcome_dataset.clj:262-282, actual sha256 at :269 vs the pinned sha256, exclusion :record-source-drift). Unchanged manifest bytes do not guarantee unchanged record bytes; record!'s refuse-on-drift (outer_learning_manifest.clj:48-60) only guards at append time. Correction from codex-11, accepted. Semantics-preserving alternatives that keep the drift check: (a) cache keyed by (manifest sha256, per-record sha256 freshly computed) — still reads and hashes all 560 MB but skips only the EDN parse, which is the dominant cost after I/O; (b) immutable/content-addressed record storage, where a path+pin hit proves byte identity without re-reading.
smallest_semantics_preserving_speedup.secondary: Prune the 20 dead /tmp/click-scan-* manifest entries (each currently a typed :record-missing exclusion rebuilt every selection) - a data fix via the manifest's own append/refuse authority, not a code change.
smallest_semantics_preserving_speedup.replay_boundary: futon2.aif.meta-outcome-dataset/produce is the exact replay boundary: same manifest + same expected pin + same read-bytes => same dataset. The only impure seam is the default read-bytes (Files/readAllBytes) and file mtime-independent sha256 verification, both of which the cache key subsumes.
